## About
Palma's Wheels & Tires is a locally and family owned tire shop on S Broadway in Denver. We sell brand-new tires, quality used tires and auto rims of all sizes, and we carry all major brands. We fix flats too.
We provide same-day servicing on all makes and models. Our prices are fair, and we work to get you back on the road quickly. Se habla español.
We're rated 4.7 from 328 Google reviews, and we appreciate every neighbor who stops by.

## Services
- New and used tires: Brand-new tires and quality used tires. We sell any type of tire and carry all major brands.
- Auto rims: Auto rims of all sizes, including luxury rims.
- Flat tire repairs: Got a leak or a flat? We can repair it so you don't have to replace the tire when a fix will do.

## FAQ
Q: Can you fix my flat instead of selling me a new tire?
A: Yes, we do flat tire repairs. One reviewer said we patched their tire in 15 minutes after another shop wanted to sell them a new one.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We offer quality used tires along with brand-new ones.
